hook: P4 續攤：bulge 鼓起，旁边還有 tumble／stumble 家族殘黨——工作室地板貼「小心鼓包與跌倒」。
script: bulge＝鼓起。tumble＝跌倒混亂。grumble＝抱怨。boggle＝猶豫吃驚。口令：鼓包寫「別踩」，抱怨寫「去服務台」。

members.senseAnchor: something that bulges out or is protuberant or projects from its surroundings; swell or protrude outwards
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 鼓包: bulge walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「鼓包」出場：bulge 一上場梗就黏住——鼓起。

related.synonyms: bump, hump, swelling, gibbosity, gibbousness, jut
